name: Star
source: Sancai Tuhui (1609), Niaoshou (birds and beasts) chapters 1-4, plate '水馬 (water horse)'; National Diet Library copy 三才圖會 106卷 [26], frame 131
treatment: genuine cut-out: a horse standing, head turned back, mane flying, a fore hoof raised
fit: placed over the group: centred on its stars, upright, 9 deg on its larger side; no star tied
subject: 星日馬, the horse of the mansion Xing: the encyclopaedia's water horse 水馬, drawn as a plain horse
honesty: A stand-in: the plate is the water horse 水馬; the encyclopaedia's own 馬 is dappled with black spots that would read as stars.
subject_role_note: the mansion's animal in the traditional 28-animal series (二十八宿禽星): horse (馬); the plate is the encyclopaedia's 'water horse' 水馬, standing in for its dappled 馬
